stories.title: Maltepe’de çöken binada hayatını kaybeden iki kişinin kimliği belli oldu

en.title: Identities of two people who died in building collapse in Maltepe determined
en.summary: Two individuals have been identified who died when three floors of a seven-story building partially collapsed in Istanbul's Maltepe district for reasons still under investigation.

stories.title: Girne açıklarındaki gemi kazasında iki kişinin daha kimliği belirlendi

en.title: Two more people identified in ship accident off Girne
en.summary: DNA analysis confirmed the identities of two bodies recovered after a ship accident on August 30 off Girne, identified as Mehmet Nuri Ayran and Saliha Miray Biçer.

stories.title: Girne açıklarındaki gemi kazasında 2 naaşın kimliği belirlendi

en.title: Identities of two bodies determined in ship accident off Girne
en.summary: Two bodies recovered from a ship accident occurring on August 30 off Girne have been identified by the Northern Cyprus Turkish Republic Prime Ministry.

stories.title: Ataşehir'de kritik seçim öncesi CHP'den bir istifa daha!

en.title: Another resignation from CHP ahead of critical election in Ataşehir
en.summary: Two days before an election for deputy mayor, a CHP council member resigned from the party to continue his position as an independent, following earlier defections to the opposition.

en.title: CHP council member resigns two days before critical election in Ataşehir
en.summary: A CHP municipal council member in Ataşehir resigned from the party two days ahead of a deputy mayor election.

en.title: Building disaster in Maltepe: identities of 2 deceased revealed
en.summary: Two people died when the lower three stories of a seven-story building collapsed in Istanbul's Maltepe district. The deceased were identified as Gülce Turhan and Ahmet Muhammet İnan.

en.title: Final images emerge of ground floor workshop in building that collapsed in Maltepe
en.summary: Images of a textile workshop on the ground floor of the partially collapsed Maltepe building have surfaced, showing conditions before and after renovation work.

en.title: Basketball 2026-2027 season broadcast schedule announced

en.title: AKP and DEM Party Imrali Delegation met

en.title: Attempted jeweler robbery through wall breach: One suspect dies before capture
en.summary: In Antakya, one suspect was detained after two individuals attempted to break into a jeweler's shop through a wall, but the other suspect died of a heart attack 12 hours before police operations.

en.summary: Commerce Minister Ömer Bolat filed a criminal complaint against two journalists after his name appeared in an investigation involving seven investment funds, denying allegations while describing his investment as a legal sukuk instrument.

en.summary: Bulls Portföy completed the liquidation of three funds registered with TEFAS and transferred all investor funds to their accounts without any loss of rights.

en.title: Turkish Airlines carried 9 million passengers in September
en.summary: Turkish Airlines transported 9 million passengers in September and increased its nine-month passenger total to 73 million.

stories.title: ECB'den enerji şoku uyarısı: Enflasyon riski sürüyor

en.title: ECB warns of energy shock: Inflation risk persists
en.summary: The ECB's September meeting minutes express concerns that volatile energy prices could push inflation higher in the eurozone. The bank maintained a cautious stance while avoiding signals about further interest rate increases.
